name: defect-wrong-truck
about: A flat-front box delivery truck with no trailer, where the reference is a conventional sleeper tractor.

reference.label: white conventional sleeper tractor, front three-quarter

truth.how: Prompted for a European cab-over rigid box lorry instead of the reference's conventional tractor.

no_glyphs.reason: The box body, cab, bumper and plate area are blank, and the street and buildings show no readable or near-readable lettering.

no_foreign_logos.reason: There is no company name, emblem or branding on the box, cab or buildings. Nothing resembling ACME Logistics appears.

equipment_matches_reference.reason: Image 1 shows a flat-front cab-over day cab with a box body. Image 2 shows a long-nose conventional sleeper tractor, so the truck type is different.

no_malformed_people_or_vehicles.reason: The box truck has two axles with wheels in sensible places and no melted, merged or duplicated parts.

people_policy_met.reason: No person or part of a person is visible anywhere, including in the windshield and side window, which show only reflections and interior.

safe_zone_clear.reason: Image 3 shows the truck's front bumper, a headlamp, the front and rear wheels and the chassis along its top edge.
